---
title: Connected apps
description: Connect Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Drive, Slack, and the other apps from Settings.
---

Connected apps live in the dashboard under **Settings → Connectors**. Turn one on and lomi. asks you to sign in, or to paste the token that app gave you. The assistant can use a connected app only after you confirm a write (a send, a new row, a new event, an upload).

The same list is on the phone under **Settings → Connectors**.

## Google

These four use the Google account you choose. Each one has its own sign-in.

| App | What you can do |
| --- | --- |
| Gmail | Read a thread when you ask. Send a message only after you confirm it. |
| Google Calendar | See upcoming events. Create one event after you confirm the title and time. |
| Google Sheets | Create a sheet named lomi. Sales, or append completed payments, after you confirm. |
| Google Drive | Upload one invoice or receipt into a lomi. folder after you confirm the file name. |

Outlook is the same idea for mail: read a thread when you ask, send only after you confirm.

## Team and customers

| App | How you connect | What you can do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Slack | Sign in | Post to a channel after you confirm. |
| HubSpot | Sign in | Use your CRM from the assistant. |
| Telegram | Paste the bot token | Send one message after you confirm. |
| Instagram | Sign in | Reply in a conversation with a payment link after you confirm. |
| Facebook | Sign in | Reply in a conversation with a payment link after you confirm. |
| Brevo | Paste the API key | Add a customer to a list, or send one marketing email, after you confirm. |
| Twilio | Paste the account credentials | Send one SMS after you confirm. |

## Books and the rest

| App | How you connect | What you can do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| QuickBooks | Sign in | Record one paid charge after you confirm. |
| Xero | Sign in | Record one paid charge after you confirm. |
| Resend | Sign in or paste a key | Send through your Resend account. |
| Cloudflare | Sign in or paste a token | Publish the DNS records lomi. returns for pay, shop, and sending domains. |
| Sanity | Sign in or paste a token | Use your Sanity project from the assistant. |
| Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code | Install from the same list | Each one uses the hosted lomi. MCP. |

Shopify, WooCommerce, PrestaShop, Magento, and Bubble stay plugins on the same page. They are not connected apps.

Some sign-in buttons stay closed until lomi. finishes that app's setup. Telegram, Brevo, and Twilio work as soon as you paste your own token.
